observations: Photo 0: Front view of a black Nikon DSLR camera with a lens attached, placed on a white cloth with 'McSteve Online Gadget Store' printed on it. The camera body has visible wear, including scuffs and dirt. The lens has a red ring near the front element.

Photo 1: Side view of the same camera, showing the top and side. The camera body shows signs of use, including scratches and dirt. The lens appears to be a 35mm Nikkor, but the model is not clearly readable.

Photo 2: Top view of the camera, showing the sensor, viewfinder, and top buttons. The lens has a label that reads 'Nikon DX AF-S NIKKOR 35mm 1:2.8G ED' — this confirms the lens model. The camera body has visible wear and dirt, especially around the buttons and grip.
All photos show the same camera and lens, with consistent background of a store shelf with boxed electronics.

claims.claim: This is a Used Nikon D7200 DSLR Camera With 35MM Nikkor Nikon Lens
claims.evidence: The camera body has 'D7200' visible on the top right in photo 0, but the lens model is confirmed as 'Nikon DX AF-S NIKKOR 35mm 1:2.8G ED' in photo 2. The seller's claim of 'Nikon D7200' is supported by the visible text on the camera body in photo 0, but the lens model is not specified as 'Nikon' in the claim — it is stated as '35MM Nikkor Nikon Lens', which is ambiguous. The lens label in photo 2 confirms it is a Nikon DX AF-S NIKKOR 35mm lens, not a standard Nikon Nikkor lens. The claim of 'Nikon D7200' is supported by the visible text on the camera body in photo 0.

No functional test is shown. The camera is not powered on, and no screen or shutter operation is visible. The condition of the lens and body is visible, but functionality cannot be assessed from photos alone.

risks.risk: Camera may not be functional (e.g., shutter, sensor, or electronics may be faulty)
risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on, focusing, taking a photo, and displaying the image on the screen.

risks.risk: Lens may have internal damage or fungus (common in used Nikon DX lenses)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the lens glass, especially the front element, to check for haze, scratches, or fungus.

risks.risk: Camera body may have internal damage or moisture damage (e.g., from storage or accident)
risks.proof: Photo of the camera body with the lens removed, showing the sensor and internal components, or a video of the camera being opened and closed.

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on, focusing, and taking a photo.
Close-up photo of the lens glass, especially the front element.
Photo of the camera body with the lens removed, showing the sensor and internal components.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
